title: Hancock: the Great Pyramid was not a tomb but a portal
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hancock: the Great Pyramid was not a tomb but a portal, about Ancient Egypt at Egypt (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So when I speak to Graham Hancock, he says, you know, I don't think that a lot of this ancient architecture, you know, for example, he says that the the pyramid was not a tomb
I I asked Graham Hancock point blank, what do you think their actual function was if they weren't a tomb? And he almost implied that they were like a a Stargate.
tellings.difference: Adds the Orion's belt alignment and the word 'stargate', and also credits Dunn, Schoch and the Book of Enoch.
tellings.link_reason: Both relay Graham Hancock's view that the Great Pyramid was not a tomb but a portal or stargate.

as_told.title: Giza pyramids aligned with Orion's belt as a stargate

related.note: Both are about the true purpose of the Great Pyramid. Dunn says it was a power plant and Hancock says it was a portal rather than a tomb, so the two claims compete.
